caption: The drawing features a square composition with a border that is lightly outlined in black and brown on a beige background. Within the square, the design is divided into several sections by bold, curving, vine-like lines decorated with turquoise-bordered black circles. The background of the square is divided into blocky segments of brown, tan, and black, some filled with a crackled pattern resembling veins or tiny branches in black on a light tan. Prominently, two large, overlapping flowers with broad, rounded petals shaded in light to dark browns and cream are placed near the center, with dark teal and black centers. Additional smaller floral or circular motifs in similar shades fill the spaces between the curving lines. The entire design is executed in a muted palette dominated by browns, tans, teal, black, and cream, with the curved, decorated lines looping throughout the composition and creating a sense of structured movement.
title: Printed Cotton
